title: rhodiola linearifolia
intro: Rhodiola linearifolia, commonly known as Arctic Rhodiola or Linear-leaved Rhodiola, is a plant species in the family Crassulaceae. It is native to the Arctic regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. Rhodiola linearifolia is valued for its adaptogenic properties, providing health benefits such as stress relief, improved mental performance, and enhanced mood. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosavin, salidroside, and triterpenoid saponins, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects.
